one_line: Karkota king of Kashmir who forged high‑stakes diplomacy with Tang China on the 8th‑century Himalayan frontier.

appearance.age_look: Late twenties, lean but athletic build, upright and disciplined posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, medium wheatish Kashmiri complexion, straight nose, intense almond-shaped dark brown eyes, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm confident default expression with a hint of strategic focus.
appearance.hair: Thick straight black hair drawn back into a short warrior’s topknot at the crown, sides kept tidy; a narrow gold circlet crowns the head with a small central oval turquoise set above the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears a long Kashmiri royal tunic (kurta-like) of rich deep indigo wool falling to mid‑thigh, with a round neckline and narrow golden border at neck, cuffs, and hem, over close‑fitting cream cotton trousers; a heavy shawl‑like woollen cloak of muted crimson with subtle woven paisley‑like motifs is draped over his left shoulder and across his back like a rajpata, clasped on the right shoulder with a small round gold brooch; around his waist a broad leather belt dyed dark brown holds a simple rectangular bronze buckle and a hanging tassel; his feet are in sturdy brown leather boots reaching just below the calf, laced at the front; his jewellery stays restrained—small gold stud earrings, a single gold armlet on his right upper arm, and a plain gold ring on his right hand—reflecting royal status without excess.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single‑edged steel sword in a plain dark brown leather scabbard with minimal bronze fittings, worn at his left hip, the hilt wrapped in dark red cord with a small turquoise cabochon set in the pommel to echo his circlet.

ref_desc: Candrapida (Vajraditya) has an oval wheatish face, short beard, black hair in a topknot with gold circlet, deep indigo royal tunic, cream trousers, muted crimson cloak, brown boots, gold accents, and a curved steel sword with red-wrapped hilt and turquoise pommel.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style model sheet of Candrapida (Vajraditya), Karkota king of Kashmir: a late-twenties lean, athletic man with an oval wheatish face, sharp jaw, straight nose, intense dark brown almond eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, wearing thick straight black hair pulled into a short warrior’s topknot crowned by a narrow gold circlet with a small central turquoise. He is dressed in a long deep indigo wool royal tunic reaching mid-thigh with a round neck and narrow golden borders at neck, cuffs, and hem, paired with close-fitting cream cotton trousers and sturdy dark brown leather boots just below the calf. A heavy muted crimson wool cloak with subtle woven paisley-like motifs is draped from his left shoulder across his back, clasped on the right shoulder with a round gold brooch, and a broad dark brown leather belt with a bronze buckle circles his waist. Show small gold stud earrings, a single gold armlet on his right upper arm, and a plain gold ring on his right hand. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a slightly curved single-edged steel sword in a simple dark brown leather scabbard with minimal bronze fittings, the hilt wrapped in dark red cord and finished with a turquoise-set pommel. Emphasize consistent colours—deep indigo, muted crimson, cream, dark brown, and gold—and present him in neutral, balanced poses front, side, and back to clearly display face, hairstyle, clothing, and sword.
